test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In this question, the statement is followed by two conclusions. Which of the two conclusion(s) is/are true based on the given statement?

**Statement: **Z > G ≥ W L < N

**Conclusions:**

I. V < G

II. Z < W

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II is true
Both conclusions I and II are true

solution:
Given Statement: Z > G ≥ W L Conclusions:

Option 1: V → False (Z > G ≥ W It gives V > G)

Option 2: Z → False (Z > G ≥ W It gives Z > W)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
